result: orders 以 order_id 为主键；order_items 与 refunds 通过 order_id 外键关联 orders。amount_cents 均为 INTEGER。完整结果见 artifacts/probes.json#schema。

query: SELECT status,is_test,COUNT(*) AS n FROM orders GROUP BY status,is_test ORDER BY status,is_test
validation_method: 真实只读查询；语义由 business-policy.md 确定。

query: SELECT order_id,created_at,paid_at FROM orders WHERE order_id IN ('O10','O11','O12') ORDER BY order_id
validation_method: 真实只读边界样本查询

query: SELECT * FROM refunds ORDER BY refund_id
result: O02 有两笔 succeeded 退款4000和1000分；O03 有 pending 3000分和十月成功2000分；O04 季内成功8000分；O12 七月成功1000分。完整结果见 artifacts/probes.json#refunds。
validation_method: 真实只读退款记录查询

query: SELECT o.order_id,COUNT(i.item_id) AS items,COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) AS refunds FROM orders o JOIN order_items i USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN refunds r USING(order_id) GROUP BY o.order_id ORDER BY o.order_id
result: O02、O03 各有2个不同退款事件，连接后商品明细出现4行；无多次退款订单显示2个商品行。items 是展开行数，不是不同商品明细数。完整结果见 artifacts/probes.json#grain。
validation_method: 真实只读关系展开查询，与外键和明细金额校验共同验证。

query: SELECT typeof(amount_cents) AS storage_type,MIN(amount_cents) AS minimum,MAX(amount_cents) AS maximum FROM orders GROUP BY typeof(amount_cents)
result: orders 金额实际存储类型 integer，范围4000至50000；币种和分单位由 business-policy.md 定义。
validation_method: 真实只读类型查询及业务文档交叉核实。
